column1: 5.5.4.2.3.9 Print - Emitter Library Records. User shall click on ‘Print’ option on ‘Emitter
Library Management’ GUI. A separate GUI, as shown in Figure 5.25, shall be displayed.
On this GUI, user shall select ‘Printer Name’, ‘properties’, ‘options’ etc., and click on ‘print’
option to take print out on network printer. User shall click on ‘cancel’ option to exit from
this GUI and go to ‘Emitter Library Management’ GUI.
